Job Description :

• Analyze performance of marketing campaigns across all channels (digital, field activation, social, lifecycle communications), identifying drivers of success and areas for improvement.
• Develop and maintain performance dashboards and reporting frameworks covering key metrics such as acquisition, conversion, CAC, ROI, and channel effectiveness.
• Provide actionable insights on customer behavior, demand patterns, and market dynamics to support marketing and GTM strategy.
• Support optimization of marketing spend by identifying the most effective channels, campaigns, and approaches.
• Work closely with Digital Marketing and BTL teams to evaluate campaign performance and recommend improvements.
• Collaborate with Product, CVM, and Base Management teams to provide insights on customer acquisition, engagement, and monetization.
• Analyze competitor activity, pricing, and GTM strategies to support better positioning and tactical decisions.
• Support forecasting and planning by identifying trends, growth opportunities, and performance gaps.
• Develop and enhance data models, tracking mechanisms, and attribution frameworks to improve measurement accuracy.
• Ensure data integrity, consistency, and reliability across all marketing performance reporting.
• Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for stakeholders.

Requirements :

• S1 (Strata 1) degree in Data Analytics / Business Administration / Marketing is minimum requirements.
• Minimum 3-5 Years experience in Advertising and Marketing, Business & Management roles
• Strong Data Analytical and critical thinking skills.

Employment Status:

Permanent (P)

wo-jpfa-JR3322.d:
Melaksanakan kegiatan operasional transportasi harian, termasuk mengemudi, mengoperasikan kendaraan, dan melakukan pengiriman. Memastikan pengangkutan personel, barang, atau material berlangsung dengan aman, tepat waktu, dan efisien. Melakukan pemeriksaan dasar kendaraan serta melaporkan masalah mekanis atau aspek keselamatan. Mematuhi peraturan lalu lintas, standar keselamatan, dan prosedur perusahaan. Mengelola catatan perjalanan, dokumen pengiriman, dan data kendaraan. Mendukung kegiatan dasar pemuatan, pembongkaran, dan pelaksanaan rute perjalanan.

Kualifikasi:

• Pria.
• Min. SMA atau sederajat.
• Memiliki SIM B1 yang masih berlaku.
• Bisa menggunakan telepon genggam android.
• Memiliki pengalaman mengemudi kendaraan komersial, diutamakan yang berpengalaman mengangkut ternak atau muatan yang memerlukan penanganan khusus.
• Mampu melakukan tugas fisik seperti mengangkat, memuat, dan membongkar muatan.
• Memahami dengan baik prinsip-prinsip kesejahteraan hewan dan praktik penanganan yang aman untuk anak ayam hidup.
• Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan interpersonal yang sangat baik.
• Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.
• Bersedia bekerja dengan jam kerja fleksibel, termasuk pagi hari, malam hari, dan akhir pekan, sesuai kebutuhan.
• Mengetahui kondisi jalan dan rute pengiriman di wilayah setempat.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
